errors.text: The predicted sub-micron grain size is incompatible with the target result of 33 ± 19 µm.
The proposed mechanism seeks essentially complete oxygen removal, whereas the target process retains approximately 1 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening while suppressing alpha-HCP formation.

The hypothesis inconsistently describes titanium getter powder as part of the alloy blend and as a separate getter layer; the target uses external titanium sponge, avoiding alteration of the equiatomic alloy composition.
Claiming that suppression of oxide-particle grain-boundary pinning refines grains is physically backwards: removing pinning generally permits greater grain growth.
The essential 1400 °C/18 h vacuum sintering treatment and water quench from 1500 °C are not reconstructed.
